Name: Simple Skills Extended
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#D8B4FE]✦ Simple Skills Extended ✦[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][b][color=#67E8F9]🌟 Level 10 was just the beginning.[/color][/b][/center]

[center]Keep growing through [b]Farming, Fishing, Foraging, Mining and Combat[/b]. Earn lasting perks at every skill level, collect additional professions and see what comes next in a colourful Skills Journal. Choose the [b]Level 100 main edition[/b] or the [b]Level 30 alternative[/b].[/center]

[center]The renamed continuation of Simple Mastery Expansion. Works on its own, with optional [color=#D8B4FE][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53457]Simple World Tiers[/url][/color] integration.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]✨ Features[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]• Automatic rewards at every earned level across the five vanilla skills.
• Additional permanent profession choices at levels 15, 20, 25 and 30.
• A Skills Journal with current effects, upcoming rewards and the full level list.
• Simplified reward windows after sleeping, with an optional GMCM switch.
• Simplify / Detailed views and per-farmer effect controls.
• Styled skill bars and skill nameplates, each with its own switch.
• Optional, SWT, SEB and SpaceCore compatibility.
• Mouse, keyboard and controller controls, plus all twelve game languages.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#86EFAC]📈 Vanilla Bonuses & Extended Progression[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53458/53458-1791344402-1624583601.png[/img]
[center][/center]
[center][b]Your unbuffed vanilla skill levels remain capped at 10, so their normal level-based benefits stop increasing there.[/b] Levels above 10 grant SSE’s listed rewards separately—they do not multiply vanilla formulas as though your native skill were level 30 or 100. Temporary food buffs, professions and vanilla Mastery rewards still work normally.[/center]

[center]Early SSE perks follow your ordinary unbuffed skill levels. Extended progression unlocks once all five vanilla skills reach level 10; Mastery level 5 and cave rewards are not required. Overflow XP is banked while the unlock is pending, then applied when you qualify.[/center]

[center]Level 11 needs [b]1,500 overflow XP[/b]. Each following level costs [b]350 more[/b] than the previous one. The journal shows your current progress and next target. The Level 100 edition can recognise overflow already recorded in native XP; Level 30 tracks new overflow after installation while retaining existing mod progression.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#D8B4FE]💎 Choose Your Edition[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53458/53458-1791344414-1056339542.png[/img]
[center][/center]
[center][b]Install one edition at a time.[/b] Both use the SimpleSkillsExtended folder and the same mod identity. Switching retains stored progression and earned professions; Level 30 only displays and applies progression within its supported range. The editions have their own reward curves.[/center]

[center]High-level yields in the Level 100 edition can exceed 100%: whole extra quantities are guaranteed, with a separate roll for any fractional remainder. This is a substantial long-term power increase.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#86EFAC]🌱 Rewards Worth Growing For[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[quote][center][b][color=#86EFAC]Farming[/color][/b]
Extra matching crops, fertilizer refunds, seasonal fertilizer retention, faster newly planted crops and quality benefits. Level 100 adds seed refunds, eligible animal-product bonuses and higher late-game rewards.[/center]
[/quote][quote][center][b][color=#67E8F9]Fishing[/color][/b]
Shorter bite waits, tackle protection, reduced catch-progress loss, a larger fishing bar and extra eligible rod catches. Level 100 also expands treasure and fish-quality benefits.[/center]
[/quote][quote][center][b][color=#86EFAC]Foraging[/color][/b]
More wood and hardwood, extra tree seeds, matching forage and appropriate seasonal forage. Level 100 also adds forage-quality benefits.[/center]
[/quote][quote][center][b][color=#D8B4FE]Mining[/color][/b]
More stone and ore, protection from your own bombs and improved eligible ladder chances. Level 100 adds gems, unopened geodes, shaft benefits and connected ore-vein harvesting.[/center]
[/quote][quote][center][b][color=#FDA4AF]Combat[/color][/b]
Extra ordinary monster-loot rolls, maximum health, faster melee swings, shorter special cooldowns and healing on eligible direct melee kills. Level 100 adds direct weapon damage and death prevention from Combat level 50, with its own cooldown.[/center]
[/quote][center]Rewards accumulate as shown in the journal. Bonus drops cannot recursively reward themselves. Quality improvements respect iridium and supported custom quality limits. Growth bonuses apply when planting; existing crops keep their stored schedules.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]📖 Your Skills Journal[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Open the game menu, go to [b]Skills[/b], then select a vanilla skill or its level number. Controller users can select it with [b]A[/b]. Use [b]My Level[/b] to return to your progress.[/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53458/53458-1791344434-2029504764.png[/img][/center]

[center]Settings stays beside Close at the top right on General and every skill tab. The journal uses persistent skill colours, a thick XP bar with its progress text inside, a large rewards panel and Stardew’s native framed scrollbar. Scroll with the wheel, keyboard or controller.[/center]

[quote][center][b][color=#86EFAC]Choose How Much Detail You See[/color][/b]
[b]Simplify — default:[/b] short bonuses, with the change earned on each level card and totals under Current Effects.
[b]Detailed:[/b] descriptions, explanations and totals.[/center]
[/quote][center][size=4][b][color=#86EFAC]✨ A Reward Window For Each New Level[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Newly earned levels show a simplified reward window [b]after sleeping[/b], following native and custom level-up screens. It lists the small rewards for that level, including precise percentages, without profession icons. Multiple levels remain queued in order.[/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53458/53458-1791344449-739652568.png[/img][/center]

[center][b]Show Level-Up Reward Windows[/b] is on by default in optional GMCM. Turning it off keeps your rewards and required profession choices. Existing levels are not replayed when updating; re-earning XP spent on prestige does not replay already-earned rewards. Cooking, Luck and other custom skills keep their own level-up windows.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]⚙ Settings & Appearance[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53458/53458-1791344456-1409725700.png[/img]
[center]Per-farmer controls manage Mariner, Agriculturist, SSE quality and crop-growth effects. Level 100 also offers vein mining, animal multiplication and death prevention. Disabling an effect preserves earned progression, professions and Fully Mastered status. Load your farmer’s save before changing these controls.[/center]

[center]Optional GMCM also offers [b]Use Styled Skill Bars[/b] and [b]Show Skill Nameplates[/b], both on by default, plus the reward-window switch. The optional [b]Open Skills Journal[/b] keyboard/controller binding is [b]Off by default[/b]; opening from the Skills page remains available.[/center]
[center]
[size=4][b][color=#D8B4FE]🏅 Unlock All Vanilla Professions[/color][/b][/size]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53458/53458-1791345080-658672747.png[/img]

Additional profession choices appear after sleeping at levels [b]15, 20, 25 and 30[/b]. Choose an unowned profession while keeping earlier choices. This normally allows all vanilla professions for that skill by level 30 without prestiging. If another mod has already granted them all, SSE continues giving rewards without an empty profession picker.
[/center]
[center][/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#67E8F9]🤝 Working With Other Mods[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][color=#D8B4FE][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53457]Simple World Tiers[/url][/color] is an optional companion. SSE supplies personal rewards; SWT supplies the farm’s selected tiers. Both work independently.[/center]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53458/53458-1791344486-1246161314.png[/img]
[center][/center]
[center]Resource bonuses add independently to the original native quantity. For example, SSE +200% stone and SWT +105% stone produce an expected 4.05× the original quantity, rather than multiplying each other’s extras. Crop growth uses native/SSE bonuses before SWT’s reduction; established crops retain their schedules. Turning an SSE growth or quality effect off leaves SWT’s own effect active.[/center]

[center][color=#D8B4FE][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53444]Simple Experience Bar[/url][/color] can display both SSE editions, banked XP and profession status. SpaceCore’s Skills page can show SSE alongside custom skills; their own progression and profession rules remain intact. Simple Skill Bars is the separate appearance-only alternative and stands aside while SSE is loaded.[/center]

[center]Mods replacing the same crop, fishing, resource or combat paths may need specific compatibility work. The effect switches provide control where systems overlap.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#86EFAC]📦 Requirements & Installation[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]• Stardew Valley [b]1.6.15 or newer[/b] on desktop.
• [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] [b]4.4.0 or newer[/b].
• Optional: [color=#D8B4FE][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/color].
• Optional: SWT, SEB, SpaceCore for their corresponding integrations.[/center]

[center]1. Choose Level 100 or Level 30.
2. Extract the SimpleSkillsExtended folder into your game’s Mods folder.
3. Launch through SMAPI.
Works with new and existing saves. Multiplayer participants should use the same version and edition.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#D8B4FE]🔄 Updating From Simple Mastery Expansion[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Remove the old SimpleMasteryExpansion mod folder and install SimpleSkillsExtended. Do not keep both mods or both SSE editions installed. SSE disables its gameplay hooks when the old mod is also present, preventing duplicate rewards.[/center]

[center]Existing extended XP, earned professions, pending choices, per-farmer effects and supported crop, animal and cooldown records remain readable through migration. No manual save editing is needed. Update SWT and SEB to their SSE-compatible releases if you use them.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#67E8F9]🌍 Languages[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Follows your selected game language: English, French, German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Turkish and Hungarian.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]🧪 Testing & Feedback[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Automated checks cover both editions, rewards, progression, migration, native gameplay hooks, SSE/SWT integration and localized menus. Skill Prestige checks cover the supported unofficial release; complete third-party adapter registration, live multiplayer and wider mod-combination testing remain ongoing.[/center]

[center]For a report, include your SMAPI log, SSE edition, relevant skill level and the other progression or gameplay mods involved.[/center]
